boiler.d: sealed vessel where water is converted to steam

boil over.d: overflow or cause to overflow while boiling

boil down.d: be cooked until very little liquid is left

boiling point.d: the temperature at which a liquid boils at sea level

boiled dinner.d: corned beef simmered with onions and cabbage and usually other vegetables

boiling water reactor.d: a nuclear reactor that uses water as a coolant and moderator; the water boils in the reactor core and the steam produced can drive a steam turbine

boiled egg.d: egg cooked briefly in the shell in gently boiling water

boilers suit.d: a loose protective coverall or smock worn over ordinary clothing for dirty work

boil smut.d: a common smut attacking Indian corn causing greyish white swellings that rupture to expose a black spore mass

boise.d: the capital and largest city of Idaho

boilerplate.d: thick plate iron used in the production of boilers

boisterous.d: noisy and lacking in restraint or discipline

boisterousness.d: the property of being noisy and lively and unrestrained
